title: EMHASS /api/v1/dry-run/<action> response
description: Response shape for POST /api/v1/dry-run/<action>. A dry run solves as POST /action/<action> does and writes nothing. When the solver ran (HTTP 200), the response carries the run record /api/v1/last-run would have served and the plan /api/v1/plan would have served. warnings and errors are the ones this request logged, and no other request's. See docs/dry_run.md.

action.description: The action from the URL: perfect-optim, dayahead-optim or naive-mpc-optim (any other is refused, and echoed here).

status.description: ok, infeasible or error: the solver ran, and status is what /api/v1/last-run would report (only an ok plan would have replaced /api/v1/plan). not-run: refused (HTTP 400) or failed (HTTP 500) before a plan was made; errors says why.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant when the run completed. Present when the solver ran.

stage_times.description: Per-stage elapsed seconds, as in /api/v1/last-run. Present when the solver ran.

duration_total_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds of the run, as in /api/v1/last-run. Present when the solver ran.

emhass_version.description: Installed emhass package version. Present when the solver ran.

schema_version.description: EMHASS_SCHEMA_VERSION; the plan columns follow docs/plan_output_schema.md at this version. Present when the solver ran.

infeasible.description: True when the solver returned Infeasible. Present when the solver ran.

error_message.description: As in /api/v1/last-run. Present when the solver ran.

plan.description: Per-timestep records, the same as /api/v1/plan's plan, with each record's optim_status. Returned whatever the status, so a caller can see what an infeasible what-if gave. Null when status is not-run.

errors.description: The errors this request logged. When status is not-run, they say why.
